summary: The product cover follows pointwise from the affine midpoint identity, the strict whole-plane cover, and complements of the closed endpoint caps. Finite subadditivity and product measure then yield the normalized and unweighted endpoint bounds. In the accepted normalized certificate, substitution at heights 0 and 2 identifies the caps exactly, and the sum identities with S correctly show that at least one endpoint family covers its plane and pays the corresponding full endpoint area. Boundary cases and the final calibration algebra are handled correctly.
